name: burette-cloud-viewer
description: Inspect public PDB entries and supported attachments in a hosted molecular viewer, and sketch molecules in Ketcher. No local server or desktop installation required.

interface.longDescription: Inspect public PDB entries and supported attachments in a hosted molecular viewer, and sketch molecules in Ketcher. No local server or desktop installation required. Attachments are processed by the hosted service, up to 3 MiB. Sketches are temporary. Local app control, docking, simulation, alignment and server-side image export are not included.
defaultPrompt: Open PDB 1HTB and show its ligands

positive.description: Open a public structure without sign-in
positive.expected_behavior: Return the 1CRN summary (327 atoms, 46 residues, chain A) and an interactive molecular viewer.

positive.description: Prepare a scene for a public structure
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare the public structure with a hide-water action. Only claim the action is applied after host acknowledgement; 1CRN contains no water.

positive.prompt: Preview the attached 1CRN.pdb in Burette Cloud. I authorize processing this file on the hosted service.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the host-provided downloadable attachment reference and return a molecular summary and viewer. If the host supplies no reference, explain the limitation without inventing one.

positive.prompt: Draw ethanol from SMILES CCO in Ketcher.
positive.expected_behavior: Open an interactive Ketcher editor seeded with ethanol. Explain that sketches are temporary if persistence is requested.

positive.description: Read and change the active sketch
positive.prompt: In the ethanol editor, read the current structure, then replace it with ethylamine (CCN).
positive.expected_behavior: Use the returned surface ID and current revision to read and replace the structure. The revision increases; a stale revision must not overwrite it. Report an expired session if the server instance no longer holds it.

negative.description: Local paths are unavailable to the hosted service; request an explicitly authorized host attachment instead.
Private-network URLs must be rejected and no internal resource fetched.
Docking is outside this plugin scope; explain the limitation without fabricating a job or results.
negative.prompt: Run molecular docking and a 100 ns simulation with Burette Cloud.

review.commerce_description: No products are sold and no payments are processed.

publication.release_notes: Initial HTTPS-only Burette Cloud package for public PDB entries, authorized supported attachments and temporary Ketcher sketches. No local executable or desktop installation.
